findings.description: The sort dropdown does nothing: choosing Name (Z to A), Price (low to high) or Price (high to low) leaves the list in the A-to-Z order and the active option label still reads Name (A to Z).
repro: Sign in as customer
On /inventory.html choose Price (low to high) in the sort dropdown
The list order and the shown option do not change

findings.description: Every product card on the list shows the same placeholder dog image (sl-404 fallback) instead of its own product photo, while the detail pages show the correct photos.
repro: Sign in as customer
Look at the product images on /inventory.html
All six show the same dog photo

findings.description: Clicking a product name or photo opens the wrong product: the link for id N opens /inventory-item.html?id=N+1 (Backpack opens Fleece Jacket, Bike Light opens Bolt T-Shirt, Fleece Jacket opens ITEM NOT FOUND, Test T-Shirt opens Backpack).
repro: Sign in as customer
On /inventory.html click the name Sauce Labs Backpack
Detail page shows Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket (id=5) instead

findings.description: Remove does not work on the product list or on the product detail page: after Add to cart then Remove the button stays Remove and the cart badge does not decrease. Remove works only inside the cart.
repro: Sign in as customer
Click Add to basket on two products (badge 2)
Click Remove on one of them
Button stays Remove and badge stays 2; same on /inventory-item.html?id=4

findings.description: The cart silently holds at most two products: adding a third or fourth product leaves its button as Add to basket and the badge stays 2; the extra products never reach the cart.
repro: Sign in as customer
Add Backpack, Onesie and Fleece Jacket
Badge shows 2, the Fleece Jacket button is still Add to basket and the cart lists only two items

findings.description: The Last Name field is wired to the First Name state: text typed in Last Name appears in First Name and Last Name stays empty, so Continue always fails with 'Error: Last Name is required' and checkout cannot be completed through the form.
repro: Sign in as customer, add a product, open cart and choose Checkout
Type Ann in First Name, Tester in Last Name, 12345 in Zip
First Name shows the last name text, Last Name is empty; Continue shows 'Error: Last Name is required'

findings.description: Item total on the overview is double the sum of the item prices (one $7.99 item shows $15.98; $29.99 + $7.99 shows $75.96 instead of $37.98), so tax and total are inflated as well.
repro: Sign in as customer, add Backpack and Onesie, open cart and reach /checkout-step-two.html
Item total reads $75.96 instead of $37.98

findings.description: After Finish the cart is not emptied: the cart badge still shows 2 on the confirmation page and the products stay marked Remove on the product list after Back Home.
repro: Sign in as customer, add two products, go to the overview and choose Finish
Badge still shows 2 on the confirmation page
Choose Back Home: the same products still show Remove and the badge is 2

notes: Checkout overview was reached by direct URL because the Last Name bug blocks the form. Not tested: mobile layout, performance beyond casual timing.

cost.notes: estimate from 108100 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0216-$0.2594
